rcBuildValidation.note: Evidence from the 2.5.0 cycle; carried forward as still valid for 2.6.0 and 2.7.0 (module-only scopes, no installer/build code changes).

codexLocalLmStudioTimingFix.rootCause: Ensure-KILMStudioEndpointReachable's own retry budget (30*2s=60s) was shorter than the managed LM Studio starter's genuine first-run contract (up to ~120s), and the starter's own process/exit code was never observed -- reproduced live during the 2.5.0 Greenfield acceptance run.
codexLocalLmStudioTimingFix.fix: The starter is now the authoritative start/timeout contract: the default retry budget is sized to its own up-to-120s window, and its process/exit code is tracked so a real starter failure surfaces immediately instead of being outlived by continued polling.
codexLocalLmStudioTimingFix.validation: Test-KIStackCodexLocal.ps1: a static assertion on the shipped default values plus fast behavioral checks (starter exit code observed, genuine timeout still fails). Negative control confirmed.

liveTargetValidation.controlledState: real LM Studio server stopped via 'lms server stop' (GUI left running) so the managed starter was genuinely required; lms CLI was already materialized from prior sessions, so this exercises the starter's server-start/endpoint-wait phase specifically, not a from-scratch first-ever GUI/CLI-materialization cold start

starterFailurePathProof.method: synthetic starter (exit /b 1) under a scratch TargetRoot, side-effect-free
starterFailurePathProof.outcome: PASS -- surfaced immediately via starterExitCode, not outlived by polling

ragLiveTargetValidation.scope: Execute (Add/Query/Replace/Remove) and Rollback of Add, Replace, and Remove all verified against a live OpenWebUI 0.11.0 instance with before/after remote evidence, each including a repeated Rollback call confirmed as a clean idempotent no-op.
ragLiveTargetValidation.regressionFinding: A partial-failure-then-retry regression test for the Replace/Remove restore path (added 2.6.0 AP01, mirroring the pre-existing Add-path scenario) found a real defect: a retry could re-issue a remove call against remote content an earlier partial attempt had already deleted, failing the retry itself. Fixed in Remove-RAGRemoteEntry to treat an already-removed target as already-satisfied, matching the real server's own behavior; negative-control verified.

greenfieldAcceptance.cycle: 2.5.0 -- carried forward as still valid for 2.6.0 and 2.7.0; no new Greenfield run was performed in either cycle (module-only scopes).
greenfieldAcceptance.environment: Hyper-V VM, fresh Windows install, no prior KI-Stack state
greenfieldAcceptance.visualAndAgentPackStatus: WaitingForUserAction -- expected credential state because no OpenWebUI administrator API key was supplied by design, not an installation failure

findings.description: A .partial file already at the exact expected size was previously re-requested with an end-of-file Range header, causing HTTP 416 from the source. Fixed to verify such a file directly via the existing size/SHA256 contract with no HTTP request; a hash mismatch fails safely through the existing invalid-artifact contract.

regressionSuites.Test-KIStackRAGStatePersistence.ps1: passed 28/28 (including 2 new 2.6.0 Replace/Remove-restore partial-failure-then-retry regressions, negative-control verified)
regressionSuites.Test-KIStackModelDownloadContract.ps1: passed 11/11 (including 3 HTTP-416 resume-fix regressions from 2.5.0, negative-control verified)
regressionSuites.Test-KIStackCodexLocal.ps1: passed 13/13 (including the new 2.7.0 LM Studio startup-timing regression, negative-control verified)
regressionSuites.completeInstallerShaContract: passed, 0 errors (against freshly extracted final build 1)

targetSystemMutationNote: RAG Execute created one isolated test Knowledge collection on the live target; Rollback (verified idempotent on a repeated call) genuinely deleted the remote file and Knowledge collection, and the local test fixture was removed -- net state fully reverted, confirmed via pre/post remote file-existence and knowledge-collection checks. This is separate from the physical Greenfield installer run recorded under results.greenfieldAcceptance, which targeted a disposable Hyper-V VM, not the persistent real target machine referenced here. Separately, the 2.7.0 Codex Local LM Studio timing fix's live-target validation stopped and let the managed starter restart the real target's local LM Studio API server (GUI left running throughout) -- net state fully reverted (server reachable again, same as before); the starter-failure-path proof used a synthetic starter under a disposable scratch directory only, never the real production starter.
